messages.content:
Project: Tiny notes CLI

Proposed tasks:
- Implement JSON notes storage module: Create notes.py with a small standard-library-only API for storing notes in a JSON file in the working directory, defaulting to notes.json. Expose add(note, path='notes.json'), list(path='notes.json'), and delete(index, path='notes.json'). Store notes as a JSON array of strings; treat a missing file as an empty list; make delete use 1-based numbering and raise IndexError for out-of-range indexes. | criteria: notes.py imports only Python standard-library modules.; add appends a note and persists it to the JSON file.; list returns notes in insertion order and returns an empty list when the file is missing.; delete removes the requested 1-based note number and persists the updated list.; Out-of-range delete raises IndexError without corrupting the JSON file. | depends on: -
- Build argparse CLI wrapper: Create cli.py that imports the storage functions from notes.py and exposes argparse subcommands: add, list, and delete. Provide a main(argv=None) entry point for testability. add takes one note string, list prints numbered notes or a friendly empty message, and delete takes a 1-based note number. Use notes.json in the current working directory by default and return non-zero for invalid delete indexes. | criteria: cli.py builds an argparse parser with subcommands add, list, and delete.; python cli.py add "text" persists a note through notes.add.; python cli.py list prints notes with 1-based numbering.; python cli.py delete 1 removes the first note through notes.delete.; Deleting an invalid note number exits non-zero with a clear error message.; main(argv) can be called directly in tests without spawning a subprocess. | depends on: Implement JSON notes storage module
- Add pytest coverage for storage and CLI: Create pytest tests under tests/ that verify the core storage module and the argparse CLI. Use tmp_path for isolated JSON files and invoke cli.main(argv) directly where practical so tests do not depend on global state. Cover adding, listing, and deleting notes, including empty-list behavior and invalid delete indexes. | criteria: tests/test_notes.py covers add, list, and delete against an isolated JSON file.; tests/test_cli.py covers add, list, and delete subcommands through cli.main(argv).; Tests verify notes persist across separate calls using the same JSON path.; Tests verify invalid delete behavior for both storage and CLI.; Running pytest from the project root passes all tests. | depends on: Implement JSON notes storage module, Build argparse CLI wrapper
